name: simulate-social-security-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual Social Security phase extracted from simulatePlan. Fifteen dedicated L block members exercise own-retirement, current/former-spouse, survivor, SSDI, earnings-test, publication-order, duplicate-ID, and floating-point hazards in all four equivalence modes; the six added on 2026-09-29 (l10 to l15) reach the family charge and both caps on its partial-month shares, the former-spouse record of a couple member from the January after the death of the spouse, a spouse who died before his claim, and an SSDI onset at full retirement age. Measured 2026-09-29 on the blocks corpus (127 members): every entry reached, no cold line; nine entries carry cold sub-line regions, reported. Since 2026-09-29 the phase is socialSecurity/householdYear.ts#socialSecurityYear, called through the annualSocialSecurity adapter. Entries split the year function into its semantic passes so any cold whole line names the missing corpus behavior rather than hiding inside one aggregate count; the paired callsite entry measures annual scalar selection and effect consumption.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every nullish, ternary, optional-chain, or compound-condition operand sharing a physical line, so cold sub-line regions must be reported and explained alongside focused helper/delegation guards.
